checked.how: Scanned every added line for hex/rgb/hsl, font names, px sizes and new materials. None found. The only numeric literals are sim tuning values (fireMargin: 4) and test constants.

checked.target: src/ui/race-ui.ts:150,193: Boost button state after per-car armed
checked.how: `const me = view.racers[0]` feeds `touch.setAction(me?.armed ?? null)`. Now that world.ts:152 sets armed for every racer, the button still follows only the player's car, so a rival taking a box can't light it (spec play-test step 4 holds).

The stage still sets `armed: i === 0 && armed, boostTicks: 0` on fixed data. Its RacerView keys still type-check after the sim change; it was not modified and needs no new stage, because the spec adds no new screen or state.

Grep 'pickups' in src/render: the boxes are shown or hidden from RaceView.pickups (scene.ts:174), which doesn't depend on which car took a box. Render has no armed or boost visuals for any car, which matches the spec's 'no new visuals'.

Opened both. The HUD corner stacks (POS/LAP/map top-left, TIME/BEST/pause top-right, steer pads bottom-left, action/brake/gas bottom-right) match the existing components. The action roundel shows mustard when armed and dirt when unarmed, per UI_RULES §1 roles. Nothing looks different from the existing pickup UI.
